description: This file defines a React component called MobilePopoverContent, which renders a modal-like popover component optimized for mobile. It incorporates other components such as Portal, MobileModalHeader, MobileModalAction, and hooks like useModalAnimation and useDisableBodyScrollOnMobile. It manages the display and animation of the popover, handles scroll disabling on mobile, and provides a structure with a header and content area.

methods.name: DisableScroll
methods.description: A React component that disables body scroll on mobile devices using the 'useDisableBodyScrollOnMobile' hook.

methods.name: MobilePopoverContent
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a mobile-friendly popover with header, content, and action button. Manages visibility, animation, and scroll behavior based on open state.
